content.short: Dojoswap is Injective's first native community-driven AMM DEX, featuring the DOJO token and deep liquidity.
content.description: Dojoswap is the first native, community-driven decentralized exchange and automated market maker (AMM) built on the Injective blockchain. It is designed to provide users with a fast, low-cost, and transparent trading experience while fostering a vibrant ecosystem for new project launches and liquidity provision. The protocol is powered by the DOJO token, which facilitates governance, staking rewards, and revenue-sharing within the community. By leveraging Injective's institutional-grade infrastructure and optimized DeFi modules, Dojoswap serves as a central hub for liquidity on the network, enabling seamless asset exchange and empowering users to participate in the growth of the Injective ecosystem.
